scope_note: Primary RICOH sources only. The English Operating Manual is the firmware-1.00 edition; Custom Images added later (SATOBI 1.31, KATEN 1.50, KYUSHU 1.60, FUYUNO 1.70, HARUBENI 1.80, Gold 2.10) are documented only on RICOH web pages. Firmware 2.20 (2024/10/30) adds Astrophoto Assist functions, no Custom Image. The ci_modes / ci_params / ci_special pages cover all current PENTAX DSLRs (as of June 2022), not the K-3 Mark III alone. 'page' is null for web pages.

default_custom_image.note: A6 Image Process Settings table, 'Default Setting' column; also Bright for movies (B6, p.26).

parameter_reference.manual: Manual p.78 (steps 3-4) shows a parameter screen ('Saturation' visible in the screenshot) and says the R button 'Switches between [Sharpness] and [Fine Sharpness]'. No per-mode table.
parameter_reference.ci_params_hue_exception: In the Muted and Bleach Bypass modes, Hue is replaced by Tone.
parameter_reference.feature_iq: "Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode."

natural.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): "provides a good balance of brightness and saturation for each light level"; ideal for all types of subjects and "neutral color reproduction".
natural.description_ko: 리코는 Natural이 밝기와 채도의 균형을 맞추는 모드이고 피사체를 가리지 않으며 중립적인 색 재현에 알맞다고 설명합니다.
natural.note: No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. ci_modes is a cross-model PENTAX page, not K-3 Mark III specific.

bright.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): an all-purpose mode for scenic photography that "emphasizes deep-blue skies and fresh, lively green leaves".
bright.description_ko: 리코는 Bright를 풍경 전반에 쓰는 범용 모드로 소개하고 짙은 파란 하늘과 생기 있는 초록 잎을 강조한다고 설명합니다. K-3 Mark III의 기본 Custom Image입니다.
bright.note: No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. Default Custom Image per manual p.24. ci_modes also says Bright is 'preferred by 60 percent of PENTAX camera users' and contains the sentence 'Contrast and Sharpness parameters are set at -1 at default to enhance overall contrast', which is ambiguous in context and was not used.

portrait.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): "emphasizes magenta shades to create healthy skin tones"; skin is rendered "with slightly pinkish tones" rather than faithfully.
portrait.description_ko: 리코는 Portrait가 마젠타 계열을 강조해 피부를 건강하고 약간 분홍빛으로 표현한다고 설명합니다.
portrait.note: No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table.

landscape.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): based on Bright, it "produces richer blue and green shades" and "enhances yellow to dramatize colored leaves in autumn".
landscape.description_ko: 리코는 Landscape가 Bright를 바탕으로 파랑과 초록을 더 짙게 하고 노랑을 강조해 단풍을 돋보이게 한다고 설명합니다.
landscape.note: No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table.

vibrant.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): "emphasizes three primary colors — blue, green and red — to capture lively images of nature and scenery", with magenta-tinted blues.
vibrant.description_ko: 리코는 Vibrant가 파랑, 초록, 빨강을 강조해 자연과 풍경을 생생하게 담고 파랑에 마젠타 기운을 더한다고 설명합니다.
vibrant.note: No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. English name is 'Vibrant'; the Japanese name is 雅（MIYABI）.

radiant.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): "High in saturation and contrast, it is designed to exaggerate each hue by raising initial key settings and deliver brighter images."
radiant.description_ko: 리코는 Radiant가 채도와 대비가 높고 키의 초기값을 올려 색을 과장하며 더 밝은 사진을 만든다고 설명합니다.
radiant.note: No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. English name is 'Radiant'; the Japanese name is ポップチューン (Poptune is not used on the English pages).

muted.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): "a high-key, low-contrast finishing touch with toned-down saturation"; a tone from eight colors can be applied to the whole image.
muted.description_ko: 리코는 Muted를 채도를 낮춘 하이키·저대비 마무리로 설명합니다. 여덟 가지 색 가운데 하나로 화면 전체에 조색을 입힐 수 있습니다.
muted.note: Partial list built from text, not a table: ci_modes says core colors remain after 'Saturation, Key and Contrast parameters have been adjusted' and offers a tone from eight colors; ci_params says that in Muted and Bleach Bypass 'this parameter [Hue] is replaced by Tone'. Names are the web pages' names, not the manual's. The K-3 Mark III top page caption uses 'Faint mode'; the Japanese special page uses ほのか where the English text says 'Faint', so 'Faint' appears to be an alternative English rendering of ほのか/Muted (inference from parallel text).

flat.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): "designed with a retouching process in mind"; contrast is set to -4 by default and it applies no color expansion.
flat.description_ko: 리코는 Flat을 후보정을 염두에 둔 모드로 설명합니다. 대비의 기본값이 −4이고 색을 넓히는 처리를 하지 않는다고 적었습니다.
flat.note: No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. The ci_modes Flat section's sample captions mistakenly mention 'the Muted mode' twice; this is an error on RICOH's page.

bleach-bypass.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): "recreates low-key, high-contrast images with subdued colors, just like old films developed by the bleach bypass process"; Tone defaults to green.
bleach-bypass.description_ko: 리코는 Bleach Bypass가 표백을 생략해 현상한 옛 필름처럼 색을 억누른 로키·고대비 사진을 만든다고 설명합니다. 조색의 기본값은 그린입니다.
bleach-bypass.note: Partial: ci_params says Hue is replaced by Tone in this mode; ci_modes says Tone defaults to green and can be turned off or changed. Other adjustable parameters are not listed in any official source found.

reversal-film.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): "designed to express images with deep black and rich colors, just like those captured on reversal film."
reversal-film.description_ko: 리코는 Reversal Film이 리버설 필름처럼 깊은 검정과 풍부한 색을 낸다고 설명합니다. 샤프니스 말고는 조절할 항목이 없습니다.
reversal-film.note: ci_modes: 'it provides no adjustment function for Brightness, Contrast, Saturation and other parameters (except for Sharpness in minute setting function)'. Source is the cross-model page, not the K-3 Mark III manual.

monochrome.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): "produces rich-gradation, monochrome images in black and white, or sepia", with tone (warm/cool) and eight monochrome filters.
monochrome.description_ko: 리코는 Monochrome이 계조가 풍부한 흑백이나 세피아 사진을 만든다고 설명합니다. 따뜻하거나 차가운 조색과 여덟 가지 흑백 필터를 고를 수 있습니다.
monochrome.note: Name conflict: the Operating Manual (p.78, p.127-128, index) calls this mode 'Monotone'; the spec page, feature page, brochure and ci_modes call it 'Monochrome'; Japanese モノトーン. Parameter list is partial, from ci_modes text ('In addition to contrast control, you can also select the desired tone ... With eight monochrome filters'); exact on-camera parameter names not confirmed.

satobi.official_description_en: RICOH (firmup, v1.31): "a finishing tone similar to color photos from the 60 and 70s with colors such as cyan blue, dull yellow, and faded red."
satobi.description_ko: 리코는 SATOBI가 시안빛 파랑, 탁한 노랑, 바랜 빨강으로 1960~70년대 컬러 사진과 비슷한 색조를 낸다고 설명합니다.
satobi.availability: Added to the K-3 Mark III by firmware 1.31 (released 2021-12-07) as a regular Custom Image; no lens requirement is stated (firmup, fw_download). Not a 'Special Edition' on RICOH's pages.
satobi.note: No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. Not in the Operating Manual (manual predates firmware 1.31).
satobi.availability_ko: 펌웨어 1.31(2021-12-07)에서 추가된 일반 Custom Image입니다. 렌즈 조건은 없습니다.

harubeni.official_description_en: RICOH (firmup, v1.80): "designed to emphasize the pinkish colors of cherry blossoms ... and the subdued blue colors of hazy spring skies."
harubeni.description_ko: 리코는 HARUBENI(春紅)가 벚꽃의 분홍빛과 봄 하늘의 흐릿한 파랑을 강조한다고 설명합니다.
harubeni.availability: Special Edition (seasons series). Added to the K-3 Mark III by firmware 1.80 (released 2023-03-09); selectable only when a compatible lens is mounted: HD PENTAX-FA 77mmF1.8 Limited, HD PENTAX-DA 20-40mm F2.8 ED Limited DC WR. Also listed for K-1 Mark II, K-1 and KF (ci_special).
harubeni.note: ci_special (EN) says it works 'by automatically shifting the hue toward the red phase'; the Japanese page (ci_special_ja) says it uses 調色 (toning) set toward red. Slight wording difference (hue vs toning) between language versions. No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. Not in the Operating Manual (manual predates this firmware).
harubeni.availability_ko: Special Edition입니다. 펌웨어 1.80(2023-03-09)에서 추가됐고 HD PENTAX-FA 77mmF1.8 Limited나 HD PENTAX-DA 20-40mm F2.8 ED Limited DC WR를 달았을 때만 고를 수 있습니다.

katen.official_description_en: RICOH (firmup, v1.50): "designed to emphasize the rich blues of summer skies and depict the fine details of dazzling white clouds."
katen.description_ko: 리코는 KATEN(夏天)이 여름 하늘의 짙은 파랑을 강조하고 눈부신 흰 구름의 세부를 그려 낸다고 설명합니다.
katen.availability: Special Edition (seasons series). Added to the K-3 Mark III by firmware 1.50 (released 2022-06-23); selectable only when a compatible lens is mounted: HD PENTAX-D FA 21mmF2.4ED Limited DC WR, HD PENTAX-DA 15mmF4ED AL Limited. Also listed for K-1 Mark II, K-1 and KF (ci_special).
katen.note: First of the four season-specific Special Editions (firmup). No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. Not in the Operating Manual (manual predates this firmware).
katen.availability_ko: Special Edition입니다. 펌웨어 1.50(2022-06-23)에서 추가됐고 HD PENTAX-D FA 21mmF2.4ED Limited DC WR나 HD PENTAX-DA 15mmF4ED AL Limited를 달았을 때만 고를 수 있습니다.

kyushu.official_description_en: RICOH (firmup, v1.60): "distinctive color renditions, with images that express the passing of autumn and the fleeting feeling of the season."
kyushu.description_ko: 리코는 KYUSHU(九秋)가 지나가는 가을과 계절의 덧없는 느낌을 표현하는 색을 낸다고 설명합니다.
kyushu.availability: Special Edition (seasons series). Added to the K-3 Mark III by firmware 1.60 (released 2022-10-18); selectable only when a compatible lens is mounted: HD PENTAX-FA 43mmF1.9 Limited, HD PENTAX-DA 21mmF3.2AL Limited, HD PENTAX-DA 40mmF2.8 Limited, HD PENTAX-DA 70mmF2.4 Limited. Also listed for K-1 Mark II, K-1 and KF (ci_special).
kyushu.note: Second season-specific Special Edition (firmup). No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. Not in the Operating Manual (manual predates this firmware).
kyushu.availability_ko: Special Edition입니다. 펌웨어 1.60(2022-10-18)에서 추가됐고 HD PENTAX-FA 43mmF1.9 Limited, HD PENTAX-DA 21mmF3.2AL Limited, HD PENTAX-DA 40mmF2.8 Limited, HD PENTAX-DA 70mmF2.4 Limited 가운데 하나를 달았을 때만 고를 수 있습니다.

fuyuno.official_description_en: RICOH (firmup, v1.70): "designed to emphasize colors depicting the chilly air of winter, and to deliver sharp, high-key, images."
fuyuno.description_ko: 리코는 FUYUNO(冬野)가 겨울의 찬 공기를 그리는 색을 강조하고 선명한 하이키 사진을 만든다고 설명합니다.
fuyuno.availability: Special Edition (seasons series). Added to the K-3 Mark III by firmware 1.70 (released 2022-12-01); selectable only when a compatible lens is mounted: HD PENTAX-FA 31mmF1.8 Limited, HD PENTAX-DA 35mm F2.8 Macro Limited. Also listed for K-1 Mark II, K-1 and KF (ci_special).
fuyuno.note: Third season-specific Special Edition (firmup). ci_special adds that it lowers saturation and tints with 'reddish browns and slightly bluish whites'. No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. Not in the Operating Manual (manual predates this firmware).
fuyuno.availability_ko: Special Edition입니다. 펌웨어 1.70(2022-12-01)에서 추가됐고 HD PENTAX-FA 31mmF1.8 Limited나 HD PENTAX-DA 35mm F2.8 Macro Limited를 달았을 때만 고를 수 있습니다.

auto.description_ko: 리코의 자료에서 Auto Select의 마무리를 설명한 문장은 찾지 못했습니다. 사용설명서는 AUTO 모드에서 Custom Image가 Auto Select로 고정된다고만 적었습니다.
auto.note: No official description of the finish found. Manual p.78: 'In R mode, the image finishing tone is fixed to [Auto Select]' and 'Proceed to Step 6 when [Auto Select] is selected', i.e. the parameter screen is skipped; the empty parameter list is an inference from that step. Not listed on ci_modes or ci_modes_ja.

cross-processing.official_description_en: RICOH (ci_modes): "distinctive colors and unique contrast, just like that created by the cross-processing technique in film"; by default it varies per shot.
cross-processing.description_ko: 리코는 Cross Processing이 필름의 교차 현상처럼 독특한 색과 대비를 만들고 기본 설정에서는 찍을 때마다 결과가 달라진다고 설명합니다.
cross-processing.note: The list is the manual's selectable setting values (spec, p.128; p.79 memo on saving F1-F3), not separate adjustment parameters; whether other parameters apply is not stated. Name variants: 'Cross Processing' (manual, spec) vs 'Cross Process' (ci_modes navigation, spec sub-heading).

gold.official_description_en: RICOH (firmup, v2.10): creates "gold-tinted images by applying yellow-toned finishes to brighter areas while expressing darker, shadow areas with bluish tones."
gold.description_ko: 리코는 Gold가 밝은 부분에 노란 조색을, 어두운 부분에 푸른 조색을 입혀 금빛 사진을 만든다고 설명합니다. 펌웨어 2.10(2023-09-07)에서 추가된 일반 Custom Image입니다.
gold.availability: Official K-3 Mark III Custom Image, added by firmware 2.10 (released 2023-09-07; fw_download: 'Added custom image [Gold]'). Regular mode, not a Special Edition; no lens requirement stated.
gold.note: No official source found that lists adjustable parameters per mode for the K-3 Mark III: the Operating Manual (p.78) shows only the parameter screen, and the feature page states 'Selectable parameters vary depending on a selected Custom Image mode' without a table. Not in the Operating Manual.

korean_text_note: description_ko and availability_ko are this project's Korean summaries of the quoted RICOH text; mode names follow the camera's English menu.
